option.name: split-test-suite
option.we_will: We will split the integration tests onto per-branch databases so that the suite runs in parallel.
option.how: A database per branch, created at the start of each run.

verdict.case_for: For contractors billed by the hour, per-branch databases run the migrations from scratch on every run, which would surface the ordering race before a deploy.
verdict.case_against: The contractor team cannot provision databases itself.
verdict.what_changes: The race shows up in CI as well as in deploys.
verdict.basis: Whether the platform team would ship work the contractors wrote.

condition.name: deploy-race
condition.what_is_true: One deploy in six fails on the first attempt because of a migration-ordering race.

option.name: fix-migration-order
option.we_will: We will make migrations run in a fixed order behind a lock so that deploys stop failing on the first attempt.
option.how: A migration runner that takes a lock and applies migrations in sequence.

verdict.case_for: On a first read, with no deploy access the contractor team cannot change how migrations are applied, so this condition is beside the point for them.
verdict.case_against: On a first read, the opposite case is weak.
verdict.what_changes: With migrations applied in a fixed order behind a lock, the ordering race cannot occur.
verdict.if_it_were_false: Without this the contractor team would have nothing to hand over to the platform team.
verdict.basis: Whether the platform team would ship work the contractors wrote.

condition.name: slow-rollback
condition.what_is_true: A failed deploy takes about 50 minutes to roll back, because half-applied migrations are unwound by hand.

option.name: extract-retry-lib
option.we_will: We will extract retry into one shared library so that every handler backs off the same way.
option.how: One engineer, replacing the seven copies behind a single interface.

verdict.case_for: For a contractor team the rollback time has no bearing on consolidating retry code.
verdict.case_against: A contractor handover adds its own cost here.
verdict.basis: Whether the platform team would ship work the contractors wrote.
